mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refresh_tokens ( user_id, token_hash, expires_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{tokenHash}, #{expiresAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET token_hash = EXCLUDED.token_hash, expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
